senses.gloss: c. (b. h.; [joined together,] chest, box, coffin, freq. (= אֲרוֹן הַקּוֹדֶשׁ) the Holy Ark, in the tabernacle and the Temple, or in Synagogues.
units: <cite ref="Mishnah Yoma 5:1">Yoma V, 1</cite> <he>הגיע לא׳</he> reached the place where the Ark stood during the First Temple.
<cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Berakhot 4:5:8">Y. Ber. IV, 8ᶜ</cite> top; <cite ref="Bereishit Rabbah 55:7">Gen. R. s. 55</cite> (allegorical etymologies).—
Keth. 104ᵃ א׳ הקודש (figuratively) a good and learned man’s soul; v. אֶרְאֵל.—
<cite ref="Mishnah Kelim 12:5">Kel. XII, 5</cite> <he>א׳ של גרוסות</he> the grits-dealer’s chest.

<cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Kilayim 9:3:3">Y. Kil. IX, 32ᵇ</cite> top; <cite ref="Bereishit Rabbah 100:11">Gen. R. s. 100</cite> <he>אֲרוֹנִי נקובה</he> (<he>נקופה</he>) <he>וכ׳ ותהא</he> let my coffin be perforated at the bottom.

<cite ref="Sanhedrin 98b:1">Snh. 98ᵇ</cite> <he>אין לך כל א׳ וא׳ וכ׳</he> there is no coffin in Palestine in which the Median horses do not eat straw (being used as cribs); a. fr.—Pl. <he>אֲרוֹנוֹת</he>.
<cite ref="Sotah 13a:14">Sot. 13ᵃ</cite>; a. fr. [<cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Ketubot 6:4:3">Y. Keth. VI, 30ᵈ</cite> bot. <he>וארון</he>, v. <cite ref="A03078"><he>אֲרִי</he> I</cite>.]
